wiki.title: Stealthy Despoilers
wiki.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right|Stealthy Despoilers, interior
Ghost ninjas are attacking tourists! Head in and defeat them!

Stealthy Despoilers is a difficulty 4 battle that is started by clicking on a Stealthy Despoiler in Seaside. They are found in the south end of the region, on the path to the Luxurious Oceanfront Homes and also at the Abandoned Dojo.

 Required 

Level 9, Any Combat Job

 Goals 

Find and defeat all of the stealthy ninjas.

 Rewards 

156 Stars
Members Only Bonus: 37 Coins
